title: Throw it
description: Throw any weapon like a trident! Supports config.
body:
In vanilla Minecraft, the throwable trident is undoubtedly a great feature. So, what if other weapons and tools could also be thrown by holding down the right mouse button, just like the trident? I think that's a great idea.
Install Throw It, and you can throw specific items in the game. You can browse or modify throwable items in saves/yourworld/serverconfig/throwit-server.toml — make everything throwable!
